original_question: Determine whether there exists a pair of Connes embeddable non Gamma factors that are not elementarily equivalent, and whether there are continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent non Gamma factors.
target_in_paper: Problem 15 in the section "McDuff and Property Gamma factors": the paper asks for the existence of (1) Connes embeddable non-Gamma II_1 factors that are not elementarily equivalent, and (2) continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent non-Gamma II_1 factors. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the official formulation: it preserves the two-part existence problem, keeps the Connes-embeddable restriction in the first clause, and asks for continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent non-Gamma factors in the second clause. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
missing_details: The ambient objects are II_1 factors, not arbitrary factors; that comes from the paper’s global setup and should be made explicit in a stand-alone version. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

To be self-contained, "elementarily equivalent" should be unpacked using the paper’s convention: M and N are elementarily equivalent iff there exist nonprincipal ultrafilters U,V on the natural numbers such that M^U is isomorphic to N^V. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

For full stand-alone clarity, "non Gamma" should be read as "without Murray-von Neumann property Gamma"; the paper phrases the surrounding section in terms of Property Gamma. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
"Continuum many" should be stated as cardinality 2^{aleph_0}.
No separability hypothesis is part of Problem 15, so none should be added. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
refined_question: Do there exist non-Gamma II_1 factors M and N that are Connes embeddable and not elementarily equivalent, in the sense that there do not exist nonprincipal ultrafilters U,V on the natural numbers for which M^U is isomorphic to N^V? More generally, does there exist a family {M_i : i in I} of non-Gamma II_1 factors with |I| = 2^{aleph_0} such that M_i and M_j are not elementarily equivalent whenever i ≠ j?
justification: This draft is targeting Problem 15, not a conjecture or theorem elsewhere in the paper, because this article is organized as a numbered list of open problems and Problem 15 matches the draft’s two-part existence question. The front matter supplies the missing ambient convention that the objects are II_1 factors and defines elementary equivalence through isomorphic tracial ultrapowers. The note immediately following Problem 15 says that a pair of non-Gamma factors that are not elementarily equivalent already exists, so, by inference, the first clause is sharpened by the extra Connes-embeddable restriction, while the second clause asks for a continuum-sized family of pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent non-Gamma factors. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
